### Day 1 - What I learned today

Today I created my first blog using Quarto. I learned how Quarto can be used to create and publish a blog.

### Data management and reproducible research

I learned about the importance of good data management and reproducible research. Properly organizing, documenting, and managing data makes research easier to understand, share, and reproduce.

### Using Git collaboratively

I also learned how to use Git for version control and collaborative work. I learned to add the students list in alphabetical order.

### Creating my Quarto blog

As part of today's work, I created a Quarto blog and explored its structure. I learned how blog posts are stored in the `posts` folder and how Quarto renders the `.qmd` files into web pages.

Overall, today I gained practical experience with **Quarto, data management, reproducible research and Git**. These tools and practices will be useful for managing and sharing my research work in a reproducible way.
